;Law and crime
*A 27-year-old [[Americans|American]] [[Christian mission]]ary is killed upon landing on [[North Sentinel Island]] in an effort to convert the indigenous [[Sentinelese]] people. He is the first person killed by the isolated islanders since two [[India]]n nationals in 2006. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-india-46286215 (BBC)]
*[[Matthew Hedges]], a [[British people|British]] academic student studying at [[Durham University]], is sentenced to life imprisonment in the [[United Arab Emirates]] after being convicted of [[spying]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-46288510 (BBC)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/nov/21/british-academic-matthew-hedges-accused-of-spying-jailed-for-life-in-uae (''The Guardian'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2018 Iranian general strikes]]
**Workers of the [[Haft Tappeh]] sugar mill company in the ancient city of [[Shush, Iran|Shush]], southwest Iran, continued their strike and protests to the unpaid salaries for the 15th consecutive day. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/features/2018/11/21/Largescale-strikes-protests-continue-in-Iran-s-ancient-city-of-Shush-.html (Al Arabiya)]
*[[Interpol]] elects South Korean [[Kim Jong-yang]] as its president, beating Russian candidate [[Alexander Prokopchuk]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-46286959 (BBC)]
*[[Chief Justice of the United States]] [[John Roberts]] replies to [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] who described the judge who ruled on Monday against his migrant asylum order as an "Obama judge." [https://www.apnews.com/c4b34f9639e141069c08cf1e3deb6b84 (Associated Press)]
*[[Kosovo]] puts a 100% trade tariff on all goods imported from [[Serbia]] and [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. The [[European Union]] says this is a "clear violation" of the [[Central European Free Trade Agreement]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-46287975 (BBC)]
